tiktok.ai_label: Turn on the AI-generated content label when posting.
tiktok.text:
Kimi K3 on 8GB RAM with no GPU: can you run a 2.78T AI model locally? Yes, but the catch is your disk.
Free guide: withhammad.com/resources/kimi-k3-on-8gb-ram (pinned comment)

kimi-k3-in-c, an open-source C engine by Fareed Khan, streams the mixture-of-experts weights from a fast SSD: 16 of 896 experts per layer for each token. You need about 1.7 TB of free SSD, and it takes about 30 seconds per token on a fast server. A local LLM without a GPU, as a proof of concept, not an everyday app.

Commented BYTES? No DM needed: the free guide is at withhammad.com/resources/kimi-k3-on-8gb-ram (pinned comment). Follow for more AI builds.

facebook.text:
Kimi K3 on 8GB RAM with no GPU: how a 2.78-trillion-parameter AI model runs locally, and the 1.7 TB disk catch.
Free guide: https://withhammad.com/resources/kimi-k3-on-8gb-ram

kimi-k3-in-c, a free open-source C engine by Fareed Khan (Apache-2.0), keeps about 93% of Kimi K3's 1.56 TB on a fast SSD and reads only the 16 of 896 experts per layer that each token needs. RAM peaked at 8.24 GB and the answer was byte-identical from 8 GB to 224 GB. The cost moved to disk: about 1.7 TB free, hours of download and about 30 seconds per token on a fast server. A proof of concept, not an everyday app.

Commented BYTES? No DM needed here. Hardware requirements and setup steps: https://withhammad.com/resources/kimi-k3-on-8gb-ram
